title: Hashable Gauntlet
prompt: Implement `Hashable` (std::hash works on a **const** T, result convertible to std::size_t), constrained `hashOf` returning the real hash, and a fallback returning 0.

tests.name: hashable types hash
tests.hint: template <class T> concept Hashable = requires(const T& t) { { std::hash<T>{}(t) } -> std::convertible_to<std::size_t>; };

tests.name: non-hashable types fall back to 0
tests.hint: Unconstrained overload returning 0 — std::hash<NoHash> does not exist, so the concept rejects it.
